title: Google Earth's Nano Banana 2 feature allows users to create fake satellite images, such as a nuclear plant in Iran; Google says the images have AI watermarks (Henk van Ess/Digital Digging)
summary: Henk van Ess / Digital Digging: Google Earth's Nano Banana 2 feature allows users to create fake satellite images, such as a nuclear plant in Iran; Google says the images have AI watermarks — The question is: what on earth is Google doing? — UPDATED, with response of Google — Tonight I typed just one sentence …
contentText:
Henk van Ess / Digital Digging :
